Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

No—orders can’t be canceled after they’re placed, so there isn’t a cancellation window. As soon as an order is submitted, the warehouse starts processing it right away. If you accidentally ordered duplicate items in the same order, tell me that and I’ll route it to our team.
